remarks: Storybook charm meets modern living in the heart of New Canaan! Ideally located just steps from the YMCA, Waveny Park, top-rated schools, and a short stroll to the vibrant downtown, this exceptionally charming Cape Cod / Colonial-style home offers the lifestyle you've been waiting for.  Thoughtfully designed and beautifully maintained, this expansive residence features 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 baths, including a rare and highly sought-after dual primary setup with luxurious suites on both the first and second floors -- offering ultimate flexibility, comfort, and privacy.  At the heart of the home, a stunningly remodeled kitchen flows seamlessly into the inviting family room, where sweeping green views of the backyard can be enjoyed from the brand new deck -- perfect for everyday living and effortless entertaining. A second oversized family / great room just off the kitchen provides even more space to gather, relax, and host.  Designed for today's lifestyle, the home also offers multiple dedicated office spaces, ideal for remote work or creative pursuits. The lower level is a true standout, featuring three expansive finished areas -- perfect for a media room, recreation space, fitness area, or additional office setup.  This home checks every box with the coveted trifecta of town water, town sewer, and natural gas.
